The long filename dialog wraps legibly. **The focused originating chip can remain mostly clipped after return**, including with slower traversal. Repair horizontal focus reveal and recheck it. The current evidence supports better identity than anonymous tiles, but does not establish superiority to the independent AI Elements list for mobile scanability.
